scope: User-approved concise captions for all 38 model-page figures; captions contain no links. Supplied caption.md source files and figure assets remain unchanged.

captions.2: RNA-seq candidate-detection workflow for 36 libraries across nine groups, with four biological replicates per group.
captions.3: Retained candidate-site counts across six editors. C388 is excluded; E72A has no retained sites.
captions.4: Median editing rates across retained sites, using each site’s median across four biological replicates. E72A has no retained sites.
captions.5: Apparent rates at C295, C388 and C871, shown as medians across four biological replicates. C388 includes endogenous reference T.
captions.6: Sequence logos around retained cytosines, from −2 to +1. E72A has no retained sites.
captions.7: Chromosome-wise candidate densities within a shared callable-C reference, scaled to 100% per editor. n denotes reference-matched candidates; E72A and chromosome Y are NA.
captions.8: Editing rates at 2,221 sites retained by both PUF10 and PUF12. Each rate is a four-replicate median; hexagons show site counts and the dashed line marks equality. Δ is PUF12 minus PUF10 in percentage points.
captions.9: Retained-site counts as a percentage of PUF12 (left) and median group-minus-PUF12 rate differences among pairwise shared sites, in percentage points (right). n denotes shared sites; E72A’s rate comparison is NA.
captions.10: PUF-ESM combines ESM-2 mutation scores and one-hot features in Ridge regression to predict C295, C388 and C871 rates and derive specificity score S.
captions.11: Top-K overlap between predicted and measured rankings among 66 constructs. Random expectation is K²/66.
captions.12: Measured versus out-of-fold predicted specificity score S for 66 constructs, highlighting the predicted Top30. The dashed line marks equality.
captions.13: Spearman correlations for five feature ablations, using grouped out-of-fold predictions for the same 66 constructs.
captions.14: Measured Top30 recovery across five feature ablations. The dashed line marks random expectation: 13.64 of 30 constructs.
captions.15: ESM-2 readout-layer sensitivity: grouped outer-OOF Spearman correlation above and all-pair/within-batch accuracy below. Pairs with |ΔS| ≤0.01 are excluded; ties score 0.5. The dashed reference selects layers within inner validation.
captions.16: Grouped outer-OOF Spearman correlations across twelve ESM-2 readout layers for 66 constructs. The dashed line marks the inner-selected-layer pipeline (ρ =0.323).
captions.17: Top15 and Top30 recovery across ESM-2 readout layers for 66 constructs. Random expectations are 3.41 and 13.64; dashed lines show the inner-selected-layer pipeline.
captions.18: Current out-of-fold and measured ranks of five highlighted constructs among 66 candidates. All five enter the predicted Top30.
captions.19: Five higher-ranked and five lower-ranked examples selected retrospectively for close predicted and measured ranks.
captions.20: All-position and TRM-only design with ProteinMPNN and LigandMPNN, using 10,000 sequences per model and design space, followed by structural screening and assay comparison.
captions.21: Non-TRM nominations before and after structural screening. Exact consensus requires both models to support the same substitution.
captions.22: Frequencies of ten nominated substitutions in 10,000 TRM-only samples per model. The dashed line marks the 80% threshold.
captions.23: Editing changes relative to same-batch controls, with two records per mean. Y37R is compared separately with both batch-2 controls.
captions.24: Mean TRM log-probability changes versus WT, averaged over eight decoding orders. Positive values indicate model preference.
captions.25: Structural modelling and experimental screening workflow. The central protein–RNA image is conceptual.
captions.26: ΔΔCP across 21 variants for the 22 residues with the largest maximum absolute changes. Colours span −0.395 to +0.395.
captions.27: Catalytic-distance and contact-deviation summaries for 29 construct records. E72-based distances are shown with E72A marked NA.
captions.28: Single-mutant preference ratio and activity retention. No tested mutant meets both ratio ≥2.0 and retention ≥0.70.
captions.29: Combination-batch preference ratio and activity retention, with the empirical Pareto frontier and highlighted G27T–K30H–Q58M lead.
captions.30: Amplicon targeting ratio versus editing output. Non-GCG editing also contributes to the ratio’s denominator.
captions.31: Five design groups organize 61 candidate entries and their priorities.
captions.32: Follow-up preference ratios and activity retention, including position-132 variants, with batch-specific controls.
captions.33: LAMAR pretraining and masked nucleotide prediction. Adapted from Zhou et al. (2025).
captions.34: Training loss and masked nucleotide accuracy during continued LAMAR pretraining on human transcripts.
captions.35: Stage I training loss and validation PR-AUC across continued-pretrained, original, encoder-frozen and randomly initialized LAMAR configurations.
captions.36: Reported Hit@K and Recall@K for 140 positive test windows. Hit@K indicates any supported site within the top K; Recall@K is the fraction of supported sites recovered within the top K.
captions.37: Base proportions at −1 and +1 around edited C in PUF10-only (553), shared (2,221) and PUF12-only (10,687) retained-site sets.
captions.38: Base-proportion differences, PUF12-only minus PUF10-only, across 101 positions centred on edited C. Indigo is negative; coral is positive.
